## Summary

I resolved ticket T-6002 by identifying the root cause of the incomplete scale-up. The docindex StatefulSet was scaled from 3 to 5 replicas, but the application's CLUSTER_SIZE environment variable was not updated from 3. This caused pod docindex-3 to start as a standby node (since ordinal 3 is outside the configured cluster), fail its readiness probe with a 503 status, and prevent the fifth pod from being created. The fix is to update the CLUSTER_SIZE environment variable in the StatefulSet spec to 5, which will allow the pods to properly initialize and enable full scale-up completion.
